text:
joelle: opened a tiny PR to the OptKit migrate guide adding a compact pair of examples (Python + Go) that show batching + KV prefetch + quant hints. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923  
parth: nice. can we use the v2 client pattern in the Go example? folks copy that directly into services.
mina: also let's avoid recommending a single quant profile. write: "recommend q3_k for short chats; q2_x for extreme memory-constrained demos" and add a one-line rationale.
joelle: updated text and switched Go snippet to v2 pattern; kept both examples under 12 lines each. added the one-liner rationale.
sam: quick ask: add a 1-line CLI smoke command so engineers can run a local microbatch check. e.g. `redwood-optkit run --profile q3_k --batch 6 --kv-prefetch`
joelle: added the CLI line in a shell code fence.
build-bot: docs-lint: warning: missing-anchor `kv-prefetch` in docs/optkit/migrate.md: people might hit this on older builds.
mina: link to canonical API page `/docs/sdk/reference/kv-prefetch` and add `(redirects from /legacy/kv)` to help older bookmarks.
joelle: switched the anchor to the canonical ref and added the redirect note.
docs-bot: preview: successful  deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4923--docs.redwood.ai
parth: tiny nit: change "use batching to save cost" -> "use micro-batching to reduce per-token cost while watching tail latency". less prescriptive.
joelle: wording updated.
mina: LGTM, approving.
parth: approved. merging once CI passes.
docs-bot: CI: green. all checks passed.
joelle: merged, thanks! i'll add a follow-up TODO to track adding an OptClient API anchor when that page lands.
